evidence_classes.label: Formal / executable
evidence_classes.meaning: proved or exactly tested in the project model

evidence_classes.label: Source-conditional
evidence_classes.meaning: inherits only under the cited paper's assumptions

evidence_classes.label: Conditional empirical
evidence_classes.meaning: estimated in the declared finite design

evidence_classes.label: Scoped implementation
evidence_classes.meaning: checks one software or protocol boundary

evidence_classes.label: Open
evidence_classes.meaning: not established by the current evidence

lanes.headline: Project identity at c=0
lanes.nesting: validated categorical inputs → paired function outputs
lanes.permitted_interpretation: the project functions agree at the declared limit

lanes.estimand: client generalized posterior under the cited loss/divergence assumptions
lanes.headline: Client-loss robustness
lanes.permitted_interpretation: source theorem under its stated assumptions
lanes.prohibited_generalization: server robustness, empirical performance, or universal calibration

lanes.estimand: within-seed isolated-minus-communicating colony-mean variational free energy
lanes.headline: Paired free-energy contrast
lanes.permitted_interpretation: lower free energy with communication in the reduced declared protocol
lanes.prohibited_generalization: general communication benefit or exact source-protocol replication

lanes.estimand: seed-mean KL from true to learned categorical likelihood by ordered step
lanes.headline: Dirichlet likelihood learning
lanes.nesting: study → seed → ordered learning steps → likelihood rows
lanes.permitted_interpretation: learning trajectory in the executed conjugate categorical design
lanes.prohibited_generalization: universal convergence rate or continuous-model learning claim

lanes.estimand: free-energy difference for redundant- and supported-column pruning
lanes.headline: Configured BMR sign control
lanes.nesting: fixed posterior → candidate pruning → signed free-energy difference
lanes.permitted_interpretation: the configured redundant/supported sign control passes
lanes.prohibited_generalization: universal structure emergence or true-structure recovery
lanes.replication_unit: not applicable; one deterministic closed-form comparison

lanes.estimand: held-out accuracy for joint NLL/L2=0.05 and RCCE/L2=0.10 configurations by contamination rate
lanes.headline: Exploratory client baseline
lanes.permitted_interpretation: finite exploratory behavior of the two declared joint configurations
lanes.prohibited_generalization: an RCCE-only effect, leakage-free calibration, universal robustness, or posterior-uncertainty BNN replication

display.prohibited: influence bound; Byzantine tol.; universal win

lanes.estimand: robust-minus-naive consensus quantity in a declared attack cell
lanes.headline: Server reweighting heuristic
lanes.nesting: study → seed/world → matched trial → agents and contamination condition
lanes.permitted_interpretation: finite, mechanism-specific behavior and the exact zero-strength recovery
lanes.prohibited_generalization: bounded influence, Byzantine tolerance, or a universal winner
lanes.replication_unit: configured seed or matched trial, as declared per report
lanes.unit: accuracy fraction or true-state probability mass

lanes.estimand: declared free-energy descent, effective-weight property, and tempered-family recovery/API transfer
lanes.headline: Variational server rule
lanes.permitted_interpretation: objective-backed properties and exact tested transfer points on the categorical rule
lanes.replication_unit: not applicable for identity; seeded path for diagnostics
lanes.unit: nats, normalized server weight, or categorical posterior

lanes.estimand: communication or policy accuracy and free-energy contrasts in declared worlds
lanes.headline: Moving / disjoint-FOV contrasts
lanes.nesting: world → seed when present → condition → agents → steps
lanes.permitted_interpretation: condition-specific communication behavior in executed worlds
lanes.prohibited_generalization: universal communication benefit or physical multi-host result
lanes.replication_unit: configured seed where reported; otherwise deterministic world

lanes.estimand: posterior, accuracy-gap, and information-gating quantities by hierarchy design
lanes.headline: Hierarchy / sensitivity diagnostics
lanes.nesting: world → seed when present → hierarchy level → agent/trial → ordered state
lanes.permitted_interpretation: behavior of the executed two-/three-level and sensitivity designs
lanes.prohibited_generalization: universal hierarchy benefit, depth recovery, or structure emergence
lanes.replication_unit: configured seed when reported; otherwise deterministic diagnostic

lanes.estimand: recovered acuity, absolute error, and mean-recovery coefficient of determination
lanes.headline: Acuity recovery diagnostic
lanes.nesting: grid point → trial → observations → recovered estimate
lanes.permitted_interpretation: finite-grid acuity recoverability in the executed design
lanes.replication_unit: independent synthetic trial within each true-acuity grid point

lanes.estimand: byte/envelope consistency and deterministic replay recomputation
lanes.headline: Protocol-v1 / replay integrity
lanes.nesting: round → ordered workers → frames → payload fields
lanes.permitted_interpretation: local transport and replay integrity for protocol v1
lanes.prohibited_generalization: encryption, mTLS identity, physical multi-host operation, or Byzantine tolerance
lanes.replication_unit: configured local process or loopback round
lanes.unit: frame, worker round, or replay event

lanes.estimand: hash and provenance agreement for one labeled aggregation run
lanes.headline: Application receipt
lanes.nesting: invocation → request/result artifacts → receipt verification levels
lanes.permitted_interpretation: declared artifact integrity and, when requested, source equivalence
lanes.prohibited_generalization: scientific validity, domain suitability, decision correctness, or acceptance
lanes.unit: canonical request, result, and receipt artifact

lanes.estimand: future preregistered paired log-score contrasts on sealed external test partitions
lanes.headline: External calibration / confirmation
lanes.permitted_interpretation: none before source-bound frozen design and confirmatory report
lanes.prohibited_generalization: retrospective positive claim or pooled dataset-population inference
lanes.replication_unit: dataset as highest external unit; seeds nested
lanes.unit: nats per observation, summarized within dataset

nesting.label: Seed when present; independence is lane-specific

no_claims: guarantees do not transfer between client, server, protocol, and application lanes
nested agents, trials, and time steps are not promoted to independent datasets
open external confirmation is not implied by formal or software evidence
source_relation: headline-result and claim-owner map separating mathematical identities, source-conditional results, conditional experiments, implementation checks, and open work
